parameters.content:
## Nestiviti — Instant Rent Quote

**What this does:** Owner enters a property address + name + email on the site's rent-quote widget → this workflow searches the live web for comparable rent data → an AI model estimates a fair monthly market rent → adds a 10% owner-lease premium → returns both numbers to the page instantly AND emails the same numbers to the owner AND queues them into a 4-part nurture sequence (see the separate `nestiviti_n8n_nurture_sequence_workflow.json`).

**Setup required before this works:**
1. Tavily + Anthropic credentials (`NEST - Tavily API`, Anthropic) — same as before, unchanged.
2. Sign up for Resend (resend.com), verify the nestiviti.com sending domain (adds DNS records — do this in your DNS host's panel, likely IONOS since that's where the domain is hosted), get an API key.
3. Add an "HTTP Header Auth" credential named `NEST - Resend` with header `Authorization` = `Bearer <your-resend-key>`. Attach it to the "Send Quote Email" node.
4. Create a `Quote Nurture Queue` table in the same Nestiviti Leads Airtable base (YOUR_AIRTABLE_BASE_ID), with fields: Name, Email, Property Address, Fair Market Rent, Lease Offer, Sequence Step (number), Next Send Date (date), Status (single line text: active/completed).
5. Activate the workflow, then copy the Production webhook URL into the site's `RENT_QUOTE_WEBHOOK` constant.

**Sample input (POST body):** `{ "address": "123 Peachtree St, Atlanta, GA", "name": "Jordan Smith", "email": "lead@example.com" }`

**Sample success output:** `{ "success": true, "address": "123 Peachtree St, Atlanta, GA", "fairMarketRent": 2100, "leaseOffer": 2325, "confidence": "medium", "rationale": "..." }`

**Top failure modes (all now return a graceful response instead of hanging or crashing):**
- Tavily returns no useful results (empty results AND no synthesized answer) for a rural/unusual address → routed straight to the "couldn't estimate" response, without ever asking the AI to guess from nothing.
- Tavily or Anthropic call errors (timeout, rate limit, auth issue) → caught via each node's error output, routed to the same "couldn't estimate" response instead of failing the whole execution silently.
- AI output doesn't parse as valid JSON → same graceful fallback.
- Missing name/email → validation error response, same as a bad address.
- Send Quote Email / Queue Nurture Sequence set to `continueRegularOutput` on error — if Resend or Airtable hiccups, the widget still shows the estimate; the email/nurture-queue step just silently doesn't happen that one time. Worth checking n8n's execution log occasionally rather than assuming every quote also got emailed.
- CORS: if the site is on a different domain than n8n, browsers preflight the POST. n8n handles OPTIONS automatically on Webhook nodes; the Respond to Webhook nodes also explicitly set `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` as a safety net.

This is an **estimate only** — always disclosed to the owner on the widget as non-binding pending a real conversation.

**2026-07-28 update:** added name/email capture, immediate quote-delivery email (Email 1 of the nurture sequence, sent via Resend), and Airtable queueing for the remaining 3 emails (see `nestivity_rent_quote_nurture_sequence.md` for full copy and `nestiviti_n8n_nurture_sequence_workflow.json` for the sender).

**2026-07-29 update:** `Queue Nurture Sequence` now runs BEFORE `Send Quote Email` (was parallel) so the email can include the real Airtable record ID — every email (this one plus all 3 nurture emails) now has a 'Yes, I'm interested — send me the agreement' link pointing at a new workflow, `nestiviti_n8n_lead_interested_workflow.json`. Clicking it marks the lead's Airtable Status as `interested` (stopping the nurture sequence) and emails the operator the lead's details to close personally — no e-signature/agreement automation, by design; see that workflow's own sticky note for the known GET-link/email-scanner caveat.

={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const f = $json.fields || {}; const recordId = $json.id || ''; const interestedLink = `https://your-n8n-instance.example.com/webhook/nestiviti-interested?id=${recordId}`; return { from: 'Nestiviti ', to: [f.Email], subject: `Your ${f['Property Address']} number: $${f['Lease Offer']}/mo`, html: `

Hi ${f.Name},

Here's what came back for ${f['Property Address']}:

Fair market rent: $${f['Fair Market Rent']}/mo
What Nestiviti would pay you: $${f['Lease Offer']}/mo

That's not a starting point for negotiation — it's the number, set above typical market rent for the area.

The question we hear most at this point: "What if a resident stops paying, or turnover runs high?"

Neither touches your rent. You're on a fixed lease with Nestiviti, not a room-by-room agreement with individual residents — your payment arrives on the same date every month regardless of who's living there or how often rooms turn over. That risk is ours, not yours.

This is still an estimate. A firm offer just needs a quick look at the property — nothing required from you yet. Over the next week or so we'll send a couple of short notes on how the rest of it works.

Yes, I'm interested — send me the agreement

Or fill out the full form here

— The Nestiviti team

` }; })() ) }}
